A.depoimento: I ordered the construction of an archer and marched a mixed force to capture the neutral village of Santarem, aiming to expand my territory and secure resources.
A.plano: Capture Santarem to expand territory and gain resources. Build an archer to increase army strength. Send a mixed force to Santarem to secure it, leaving a small garrison at Lisboa.

A.depoimento: I have ordered the construction of archers at Lisboa and sent my best troops to attack the neutral villages of Evora and Coimbra. My kingdom expands!
A.plano: Capture Evora and Coimbra to expand territory and gain resources. Build archers at Lisboa to replace losses and grow the army. Consolidate forces before moving further. Do not attack Badajoz yet, focus on the closer targets.

B.depoimento: I have ordered my armies to attack the neutral villages of Tarragona and Girona. With my forces, I expect to capture them quickly and begin my expansion across the map.
B.plano: Capture Tarragona and Girona to secure resources and expand. Then move south to Valencia and Zaragoza, building up forces with archers and knights. Aim to control the eastern coast and inland trade routes.

A.depoimento: I have ordered my armies to attack the neutral villages of Badajoz and Porto, sending enough troops to ensure victory. I also dispatched reinforcements from the capital to Evora, preparing for the assault on Faro. In my cities, I built a knight in Lisboa and spearman in Santarem to strengthen my forces.
A.plano: Expand by conquering Badajoz and Porto to gain resources and territory. Reinforce Evora with troops from Lisboa to prepare for the capture of Faro next turn. Build a knight in Lisboa and spearman in Santarem to grow the army. Focus on securing the border villages.

B.depoimento: We launch coordinated attacks from Tarragona and Girona to seize the neutral villages of Zaragoza, Castellon, and Huesca. Barcelona builds spearman and sends archers to reinforce Tarragona. Our forces push east to secure new territories and resources.
B.plano: Expand east: capture Zaragoza, Castellon, and Huesca this turn. Next, move south to Valencia and Teruel, then west toward Madrid. Build archers and spearman to maintain momentum. Aim to control 18 villages or eliminate all enemies.

A.depoimento: Turn 4: I have consolidated my holdings and captured Badajoz and Porto. Now I am turning my attention to the neutral villages. I am sending my elite troops from Evora to capture Faro, while reinforcing Coimbra with troops from Santarem, Lisboa, and Porto to prepare for the push into Salamanca. My economy is growing as I build new troops to replace the ones I send.
A.plano: Attack Faro with Evora's troops to secure a new village. Send all available troops from Santarem, Lisboa, and Porto to Coimbra to build a strong army for the next attack on Salamanca. Build archers and a knight to replace the sent troops. Focus on securing the path to Madrid and the unexplored east.

B.depoimento: Our hold on the east is firm. We now strike on three fronts: archers to Valencia and Madrid, knights to Pamplona. The enemy's defenses will crumble under simultaneous assault.
B.plano: This turn we reinforce our fronts: send Tarragona's archers to Castellon, Huesca's archers to Zaragoza, and Girona's knight to Huesca. Build archers in Barcelona and Girona, spearman in Tarragona. Next turn, launch coordinated attacks: Castellon archers take Valencia, Zaragoza archers take Madrid, Huesca knights take Pamplona. Then continue south to Murcia and west to Teruel, building more troops to maintain momentum toward 18 villages.

A.depoimento: I am focusing on building archers across all my villages and sending reinforcements to Coimbra. This will allow us to launch an overwhelming attack on Salamanca next turn, securing another village and expanding our territory.
A.plano: Reinforce Coimbra heavily with archers and knights from Lisboa and Santarem to prepare a massive attack on Salamanca next turn. Build archers in all villages to increase our overall firepower and counter the neutral spearmen.

B.depoimento: Our armies strike at Madrid and Pamplona this turn, taking key neutral villages to expand our territory. Reinforcements flow to Castellon and Huesca to prepare for the next pushes south and west. We build a mix of spearmen, archers, and knights to balance our forces.
B.plano: This turn we launch attacks on Madrid from Zaragoza and Pamplona from Huesca, while reinforcing Castellon for the Valencia push next turn. We build archers in Barcelona, knights in Tarragona and Girona, spearmen in Castellon and Zaragoza, and an archer in Huesca. Next turn, Castellon attacks Valencia with spearmen and archers, Zaragoza (reinforced) pushes towards Toledo/Salamanca, and Huesca (reinforced) pushes towards Burgos. We continue building to maintain momentum and reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: We launched a massive assault on Salamanca with our elite forces from Coimbra, aiming to secure a crucial foothold in the north. Meanwhile, our villages worked diligently, producing archers and spearman to reinforce our growing empire.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca with Coimbra's army to expand our territory. Build archers and knights in all available villages to increase our overall firepower and prepare for the next expansion towards Madrid.

B.depoimento: I am launching a triple offensive to secure the neutral villages of Valencia, Teruel, and Salamanca. My forces from Castellon, Zaragoza, and Madrid are marching to capture these key settlements, while my other villages busy themselves with building knights and archers to reinforce the front lines.
B.plano: Capture the three neutral villages Valencia, Teruel, and Salamanca this turn to expand my territory to 11 villages. Use Castellon's spearman and archers for Valencia, Zaragoza's spearman and newly built archers for Teruel, and Madrid's archers and knight for Salamanca. Next turn, build up forces in Madrid and Pamplona to attack Burgos and Toledo, pushing westward toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: We launch a decisive strike on Madrid from Salamanca with our full garrison, aiming to crush the weak enemy defense and secure our ninth village. Simultaneously, we reinforce Salamanca with troops from neighboring provinces to guard our borders, while our workshops produce a massive wave of knights and archers to fuel our march to victory.
A.plano: Attack Madrid from Salamanca with all 12 troops to conquer our 9th village. Reinforce Salamanca with troops from Badajoz, Porto, and Coimbra to defend it after the attack. Build knights and archers in all available villages to rapidly expand our army for the next phase of the campaign.

B.depoimento: I am focusing my immediate efforts on capturing the neutral village of Teruel to expand my territory. I have ordered Zaragoza to launch a decisive attack with a mix of spearmen and archers, while Valencia sends reinforcements. Meanwhile, I am building up my armies across the kingdom to prepare for the next phase of the campaign.
B.plano: Capture the neutral village of Teruel this turn using a mixed force from Zaragoza. Send reinforcements from Valencia to secure it. Build up troops across my villages, focusing on Madrid and Pamplona, to prepare for the next pushes towards Toledo and Burgos, aiming to open the western front towards the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: Our armies strike on three fronts today: Madrid crushes the weak garrison of Zaragoza, Badajoz seizes the neutral Toledo, and Porto captures Vigo. We build archers across the realm to swell our ranks and march Salamanca's forces to reinforce Madrid, securing our gains for tomorrow.
A.plano: Launch a three-pronged attack: Madrid takes Zaragoza, Badajoz takes Toledo, and Porto takes Vigo. Simultaneously, march Salamanca's troops into Madrid to reinforce our border capital after the attack. Build archers and knights across all available villages to swell our ranks and prepare for the next phase of expansion toward the unexplored center.

B.depoimento: I'm attacking Burgos to expand my territory, while reinforcing Zaragoza against the enemy's Madrid garrison. The enemy just conquered Madrid, so I'm securing my border while pushing westward. I'm also preparing for an attack on Toledo by sending knights to Teruel.
B.plano: Capture Burgos from Pamplona this turn to expand westward. Reinforce Zaragoza with archers and knights from Huesca and Tarragona to defend against Madrid. Send knights from Castellon to Teruel to prepare for an attack on Toledo next turn. Build spearman across all villages for future pushes towards the enemy capital. Aim to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: King A's forces move to secure the borders. Madrid's army strikes at Zaragoza, while reinforcements pour into Toledo and Vigo. The building program is in full swing to field a larger army.
A.plano: Reinforce Toledo and Vigo for next turn's attacks. Attack Zaragoza from Madrid to capture it. Build troops across all villages to swell ranks. Next turn, attack Teruel from Toledo and Burgos from Vigo. Capture Cordoba and Sevilha to expand south.

B.depoimento: I ordered the entire garrison of Burgos to attack Vigo, aiming to capture it and expand my western border. From Teruel, I sent two knights and an archer to assault Toledo, leaving three spearmen to defend the village. I reinforced Zaragoza with four spearmen from Huesca and sent an archer from Zaragoza to Teruel to bolster its defenses. Across my realm, I ordered the construction of spearmen in every village that can afford them, building up my armies for the next push toward 18 villages.
B.plano: Expand westward by capturing Vigo from Burgos and Toledo from Teruel this turn. Reinforce Zaragoza with spearman from Huesca and Teruel with an archer from Zaragoza to hold the line against Madrid. Build spearman in all villages to grow forces for the next push. Next turn, assess losses and victories, then target Murcia and Salamanca to reach the 18-village threshold. Continue building and reinforcing border villages to maintain momentum toward the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: This turn, I launched a double offensive to expand my territory. From Madrid, I sent archers to capture the undefended Burgos, while Toledo's knights and spearmen marched on the neutral Cordoba. I also began reinforcing Porto to prepare for the assault on Vigo. My borders remain secure with sufficient garrisons in Madrid and Toledo.
A.plano: Conquer Burgos from Madrid and Cordoba from Toledo this turn. Reinforce Porto from Coimbra and Salamanca to prepare for the attack on Vigo next turn. Build knights and archers across all villages to swell ranks. Next turn, attack Vigo from Porto and Teruel from Toledo.

B.depoimento: This turn we attacked Porto from Vigo with a spearman and knight, hoping to capture the weakly defended enemy village. We reinforced our border villages of Zaragoza, Teruel, and Burgos with troops from interior villages to prepare for enemy counterattacks. We also built new troops in all our villages, focusing on spearman for numbers and knights for counter power.
B.plano: Capture Porto from Vigo to expand westward. Reinforce Zaragoza, Teruel, and Burgos to hold the line against enemy attacks and prepare for future offensives on Madrid and Toledo. Build spearman and knights across all villages to grow our army. Next turn, assess the situation and consider attacking Salamanca or Murcia to increase our village count toward 18.

A.depoimento: King A has ordered a grand simultaneous offensive! Our armies have marched from Porto to Vigo, Madrid to Burgos, Faro to Sevilha, and Cordoba to Murcia. At the same time, we are reinforcing our border villages and building a vast army of archers to prepare for the next push towards the enemy heartland. The fate of the peninsula is in our hands!
A.plano: We are launching a massive offensive this turn to conquer Vigo, Burgos, Sevilha, and Murcia simultaneously. This will bring our village count to 15. We are reinforcing Toledo, Porto, Madrid, and Faro for the next wave of attacks towards Teruel and Zaragoza. We must hold our newly conquered territories and continue building archers to maintain our momentum.

A.depoimento: I ordered the attack on Valencia with the garrison from Murcia. I reinforced Burgos with troops from Vigo and Madrid to prepare for the assault on Pamplona. I also sent knights from Lisbon to Toledo to strengthen our eastern front. I built knights and archers across my villages to grow our army for the next wave of conquests.
A.plano: We are attacking Valencia with Murcia's troops and Sevilha is being conquered by Faro's army. We are reinforcing Burgos with Vigo and Madrid troops to prepare for the attack on Pamplona. We are reinforcing Toledo with Lisboa's knights to prepare for Teruel. We need to build as many knights and archers as possible to maintain our offensive. Our goal is to reach 18 villages. Next turn, we should assess the results of Sevilha and Valencia, and launch the Pamplona attack if Burgos is strong enough.

B.depoimento: I have ordered a full mobilization of my troops towards Zaragoza, preparing a massive assault on Madrid. My southern flank is reinforced by sending veterans from Teruel to Valencia. All villages are working at full capacity to forge a new army. The enemy will not expect the storm coming from the north!
B.plano: Concentrate all available forces on Zaragoza to launch a decisive attack on Madrid next turn. Reinforce Valencia from Teruel to secure the southern flank against Murcia. Build spearmen and archers across all villages to replenish losses and maintain momentum. After taking Madrid, push west towards Salamanca and the enemy capital Lisbon to achieve the 18-village victory threshold.

A.depoimento: I have ordered the armies of Toledo and Burgos to strike at Teruel and Pamplona respectively. This should bring my total to 17 villages. I am also reinforcing Murcia and Burgos to prepare for the next phase of the campaign, aiming to cut the enemy's territory and move towards their capital.
A.plano: Attack Teruel and Pamplona to reach 17 villages. Send Madrid's troops to Burgos to reinforce after the attack. Build troops in all villages to prepare for the next push towards Valencia and the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: For the glory of King B! Our armies have struck at Madrid and Murcia, while reinforcements rush to our borders. The enemy's defenses crumble before our might. We will not stop until the realm is united under our rule!
B.plano: We are launching a two-pronged attack: Madrid and Murcia fall this turn. Reinforcements are sent to secure our borders and prepare for further expansion. We are building knights everywhere to counter the enemy's archers. Next, we will push from Madrid to Salamanca and Toledo, and from Murcia to Cordoba, aiming to hold 18 villages soon.

A.depoimento: King A has ordered the final push to secure victory! The elite forces from Teruel march to Valencia and Castellona, while the archers of Pamplona strike at Huesca. Reinforcements rush to Pamplona to hold the line against the enemy's counter-offensive. We are on the verge of claiming the 18 villages needed for absolute dominion!
A.plano: Attack Valencia, Castellon, and Huesca to reach 18+ villages and secure the win condition. Reinforce Pamplona from Burgos to defend against the incoming enemy army. Build troops in all villages to replenish the forces sent to the front. Do not attack Madrid or Zaragoza yet as their defenses are too high.

B.depoimento: Our armies strike at the enemy's weak points: Toledo, Murcia, Burgos, and Salamanca fall to our coordinated assault. Reinforcements pour into our border villages to hold the line. We are building knights and archers everywhere to fuel the next phase of the war.
B.plano: We are launching a coordinated offensive on four fronts: Madrid sends spearmen to Toledo and knights to Burgos and Salamanca; Valencia sends knights to Murcia. We reinforce our border villages with troops from the interior to secure our flanks. We build knights and archers at all villages to replenish our forces. After these victories, we will consolidate our new territories and prepare to attack Teruel and the unexplored regions, aiming to hold 18 villages.

A.depoimento: We are on the verge of victory! By sending our elite archers and knights from Pamplona, we will conquer Huesca and finally reach the 18-village threshold needed to secure our crown. At the same time, we are rushing reinforcements to Toledo to repel the enemy's counter-offensive, while Valencia's troops move to Castellon to set up our next assault on Tarragona. Our villages are working overtime, building archers to replenish our ranks and ensure the enemy cannot stop our march to dominance!
A.plano: Attack Huesca from Pamplona with archers and knights to conquer it and reach 18 villages. Reinforce Toledo from Badajoz, Cordoba, and Teruel to defend against the incoming enemy army. Reinforce Castellon from Valencia to prepare for an attack on Tarragona next turn. Build archers in all villages to rebuild our forces.

B.depoimento: This turn, our armies marched on Castellon, Vigo, Teruel, and Toledo. We reinforced our borders by sending troops from Barcelona to Tarragona and from Madrid to Burgos. We built knights across our realm to grow our military strength. We expect to conquer several enemy villages next turn.
B.plano: We are launching a coordinated offensive on multiple fronts. Tarragona sends knights to Castellon, Burgos sends knights to Vigo, Zaragoza sends archers to Teruel, and Madrid sends reinforcements to Toledo (joining the marching spearmen) and to Burgos. We build knights at all villages to replenish our forces. After these attacks, we will consolidate our new territories and prepare to attack Salamanca and the unexplored regions, aiming to hold 18 villages.

A.depoimento: Our armies march on Madrid! The traitor King B will fall. Reinforcements rush to the borders to secure our gains. We will have 18 villages by dawn.
A.plano: Attack Madrid from Salamanca and Toledo to conquer it and reach 18 villages. Reinforce Salamanca and Toledo from interior villages with knights and archers to maintain defense. Reinforce Vigo from Porto, Valencia from Murcia, and build in all villages to increase our forces. Hold Huesca and Pamplona for now.

B.depoimento: Turn 19: Our armies strike on four fronts! The archers of Teruel march on Valencia, the knights of Tarragona assault Castellon, Zaragoza's vast host descends upon Pamplona, and Burgos's troops attack Vigo. We also begin rebuilding our forces, producing knights and archers in our major villages to sustain the momentum of our conquest. The goal is to secure these four villages and push our total towards the 18 needed for victory.
B.plano: We are launching a coordinated multi-front offensive to conquer Valencia, Castellon, Pamplona, and Vigo this turn. Teruel sends archers to Valencia, Tarragona sends knights to Castellon, Zaragoza sends a massive spear and knight force to Pamplona, and Burgos attacks Vigo. We build knights and archers across our villages to replenish our forces and prepare for the next phase of the campaign towards Salamanca and the unexplored south.

A.depoimento: King A orders the assault on Teruel from Toledo, sending a formidable force of 10 archers and 4 knights. To secure our northern border, reinforcements are dispatched from Huesca to Pamplona to repel the enemy's imminent attack. Across the kingdom, our villages work tirelessly, forging new knights and archers to strengthen our hold on the peninsula.
A.plano: Conquer Teruel from Toledo to reach 18 villages. Send 10 archers, 4 knights from Toledo to Teruel. Reinforce Pamplona from Huesca with 5 archers, 2 knights to defend against the incoming enemy army. Build knights and archers in all villages to replenish our forces.

B.depoimento: This turn, we are building up our forces and repositioning troops. Barcelona sends two knights to Tarragona to reinforce the Castellon front. Valencia sends two archers to Teruel to prepare for an attack on Murcia. We build knights and archers in our villages to grow our army. Next turn, we will launch attacks on Castellon and Murcia with concentrated forces.
B.plano: Our campaign focuses on taking Castellon and Murcia to expand our territory. This turn, we move knights from Barcelona to Tarragona to form a strong knight force to attack Castellon next turn. We also move archers from Valencia to Teruel to build up an archer force for an attack on Murcia. We build knights and archers across our villages to replenish our armies. After taking Castellon and Murcia, we will push further south towards the unexplored villages. We keep our other border villages defended for now.

A.depoimento: My armies march on Zaragoza! With 4 knights from Madrid, we will crush the garrison and secure our 18th village. This will also free Huesca from its isolation. Salamanca sends reinforcements to Madrid to keep our capital strong. We build across the realm to ensure our victory.
A.plano: Attack Zaragoza from Madrid with 4 knights to secure the 18th village and open the road to Huesca. Reinforce Madrid from Salamanca with 5 archers and 2 knights. Build archers and knights across all villages to replenish forces. Do not attack Burgos yet; prioritize holding Huesca by taking Zaragoza first.

B.depoimento: To war! Our knights ride from Tarragona to Castellon, while our spearmen charge from Pamplona to Huesca. We reinforce our borders and build new troops. The enemy will fall before our might!
B.plano: Our campaign this turn focuses on a two-front attack. We will send knights from Tarragona to capture Castellon, and spearmen from Pamplona to capture Huesca. We are also reinforcing Zaragoza and Tarragona to secure our borders. We build knights in all our villages to rebuild our forces. After these conquests, we will use Castellon to link our forces and plan an attack on Murcia, while Huesca secures our north. Our goal is to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: I sent my knights from Zaragoza to defend Huesca against the enemy attack. I also reinforced Zaragoza from Madrid. I built troops in all my villages to strengthen my forces. I am determined to hold my 18 villages and win the game.
A.plano: Defend Huesca by sending all 3 knights from Zaragoza. Reinforce Zaragoza with 2 archers and 1 knight from Madrid. Build troops in all villages to grow army. Hold 18 villages for win. Next turn, check if Huesca held, then focus on reinforcing borders and preparing for enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: We dealt a heavy blow to King A's eastern defenses, sending knights from Tarragona and Pamplona to take Castellon and Zaragoza. Our builders worked tirelessly, producing a massive contingent of knights to fuel our next advance.
B.plano: Focus on the eastern front. Attack Castellon with 3 knights from Tarragona and Zaragoza with 3 knights from Pamplona. Both have defense 10 and will fall. Build 10 knights, 2 archers, and 1 spearman across all villages to reinforce for the next turn's push towards Huesca and Teruel.
